stem.text: A source emits a sound wave of a single frequency. The Doppler effect causes a different frequency of sound to be heard by a stationary observer.
What is a requirement for the Doppler effect to occur?

A.text: a source that is moving as it produces the sound wave

B.text: a source that produces a polarised sound wave

C.text: a source that produces a sound wave of changing amplitude

D.text: a source that produces a sound wave of changing frequency
